narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Eleven is bigger than five, so it must end on a bigger number.
<bookmark mark='test'/>Test it with eleven, which doubled is twenty two, and adding four gives twenty six.
<bookmark mark='end'/>Half of that is thirteen, and thirteen take away eleven is two.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Both starts end in the same place, so the size of the start did not matter.
